blocks.text: North Surrey is a broad board area, not a single neighbourhood. It stretches from the Fraser River and Surrey City Centre out toward Guildford, Fraser Heights, and the Langley border. North Surrey homes for sale include new condos beside SkyTrain, older houses, townhouses, and a few larger lots. Fleetwood is a neighbouring part of Surrey, but it is not one of the board’s North Surrey sub-areas.

The Expo Line (Scott Road, Gateway, Surrey Central, and King George stations) and Highway 1 are the main ways in and out, depending on which pocket you choose. Schools, shopping, and the daily commute feel different from one community to the next, so it pays to look at the specific area, not a single picture of living in North Surrey.

items.t: . This is the urban core, with new condos, SkyTrain, Central City, SFU’s Surrey campus, and Holland Park. It suits people who want to walk to transit and shops.

. Established streets of older houses, closer to Scott Road and with easier access to SkyTrain than Fraser Heights, plus some newer townhouses and duplexes.
. Older family homes just north of City Centre, around Bolivar Park and Invergarry Park, with a quieter suburban feel.
. A smaller, river-adjacent pocket near the Pattullo Bridge, with older houses and some newer townhouses, mixed in with industrial land. Check zoning and flood mapping with the City.
. A hillside pocket of mostly houses, described on the Royal Heights page.
. A small, more rural corner of northeast Surrey, near Highway 1 and the Langley border, with larger lots and some acreages. It has a very different feel from City Centre.

blocks.text: North Surrey real estate can mean a condo by the station or a house by the highway. The right choice depends on which of these communities you actually want to live in.

faq.q: Do I need a home inspection when buying in North Surrey?
faq.a: It is strongly recommended. Make the offer subject to an inspection so a qualified inspector can look at the roof, structure, drainage, electrical and heating before you remove conditions.

faq.q: Can I add a suite or coach house to a house in North Surrey?
faq.a: BC's small-scale multi-unit housing rules allow more homes on many urban lots, but each municipality sets the details and many lots are excluded. Check the lot's zoning with the municipality before you plan a suite or coach house.
